description.fun: Magby's breath tells you how it's feeling: healthy Magby breathe yellow flames, tired ones puff out flames mixed with black smoke, and one with a cold drips flames from its nose. It's small and timid, and leaks flames when it's excited or startled. After a long day it soaks in volcanic magma to recover.
description.guide: A small, red Fire baby Pokémon introduced in Generation 2 with a yellow beak and a flame-shaped mark on its belly. It breathes hot flames, and their colour shows its health. It evolves into Magmar, which evolves into Magmortar.
description.tagline: A timid baby whose flames show how it feels

description.fun: Magmar's body burns at around 1,200°C, so it glows orange, and it hates the cold so much that it lives in and around volcanoes and spits fire to keep its surroundings warm. When it's losing a fight, it melts into any nearby blaze, using its flickering body as camouflage. It's feared as one of the causes of fires, and it has a bad habit of burning its prey to a crisp.
description.guide: A red and yellow Fire Pokémon with a duck-like beak and a flame on its tail, the evolution of Magby. It lives near volcanoes and its body burns at about 1,200°C. It evolves into Magmortar when traded holding a Magmarizer, and may be based on the Karura, a fire-breathing bird-like being from Japanese myth.
description.tagline: A fire-breathing duck that hides in flames

description.fun: Magmortar's arms work like cannons: its claws pull back into its skin and it fires fireballs of over 2,000°C that can melt through iron, though a full barrage starts to melt its own arms. It stokes its inner fire by breathing in deeply. Some factories still rely on its flames to process metal, and only a single pair is said to live in any one volcano.
description.guide: The final form of Magby, a large, red and yellow Fire Pokémon introduced in Generation 4. It evolves from Magmar when traded holding a Magmarizer, and its arms act as cannons that shoot extremely hot fireballs. It lives in volcanic craters.
description.tagline: Arms that fire fireballs like cannons

note.text: Magby is a baby Pokémon, added in Generation 2, a generation after the Magmar it grows into.
